mapper.insert: INSERT INTO training_video_history ( user_id, video_id, activity_date, completed, duration_sec, memo, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{videoId}, #{activityDate}, #{completed}, #{durationSec}, #{memo}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE training_video_history SET completed = #{completed}, duration_sec = #{durationSec}, memo = #{memo}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT video_id FROM training_video_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND completed = 1
